Module 1: Personnel Hygiene & Behavioral.Description: Staff observed washing hands for 20s before cooking.
Handwashing observed after touching face, phone, or trash.
No bare-hand contact with Ready-to-Eat (RTE) pasta/bread.
Service gloves changed when soiled or task switching.
Hand sinks fully stocked with soap & paper towels.
All kitchen staff wearing effective hair/beard nets.
No jewelry worn except for a plain wedding band.
Uniforms are clean; no staff working in personal clothes.
[LOG CHECK] LOG-GHP-01 current and signed by manager.
Staff can correctly explain the '48-hour sickness rule.'
Personal items (phones, bags, drinks etc.,) are stored in designated areas and not permitted in food zones.

Module 2: Thermal Control & The 'Kill St.Description: Fried Chicken batch internal temp ≥ 165° F for 15s.
Probe thermometers sanitized before/after each use.
[LOG CHECK] LOG-COOK-01 shows entries for every batch today.
No room-temp thawing observed on prep tables.
Pasta cooled from 135° F to 70° F within 2 hours.
Chiller/Reach-in units maintain food temp ≤ 41° F.
Freezer maintains food solid at ≤ 0° F.
Permanent hanging thermometers present in all units.
[LOG CHECK] LOG-TEMP-01 (AM/PM checks) has no gaps.
LOG-CAL-01 (Weekly Ice point) is up to date.
Digital probes are accurate within ±2° F (Auditor verification).
Thawing items stored on the bottom shelf of refrigeration.

Module 3: Preparation, Breading & Cross-.Description: Breading flour sifted every 2 hours (removed dough balls).
Breading 'dip' water changed and basin sanitized every 2 hours.
[LOG CHECK] LOG-BREAD-01 is initialed and current.
Red tongs used for raw chicken; Green/White for RTE foods.
Sifters and breading bins are stainless steel/food-grade plastic.
Separation of at least 4ft maintained between raw and RTE prep.
Raw chicken stored strictly below cooked pasta/veg in chiller.
Wiping cloths stored in sanitizer buckets between uses.
All raw proteins (incl. staff ingredients) are stored strictly below RTE items.

Module 4: Supply Chain, Traceability & L.Description: Incoming TCS deliveries ≤ 41° F (verified by staff).
[LOG CHECK] LOG-REC-01 includes temp data for all batches.
All prep containers labeled with Prod Date + Expiry.
Open dry goods (flour/pasta) decanted or sealed.
[LOG CHECK] LOG-TRACE-01 links Commissary # to Batch ID.
FIFO rotation followed (Older stock in front).
No expired ingredients found in walk-in, dry storage, or prep.
Packaging is free of leaks, dents, or signs of tampering.
Food stored 6 inches off the floor on approved racking.

Module 5: Sanitation, Pests & Infrastruc.Description: All utensils/pans air-dried; no towels used.
[LOG CHECK] LOG-CLN-01 identifies D/W tasks completed.
No evidence of rodent droppings or gnaw marks.
No active fly or cockroach activity in food zones.
Hole in the back door remains permanently sealed.
Grease trap waste layer < 25% of total depth.
PCO professional service report on file for the current month.
Exhaust hood filters are free of dripping grease.
All light bulbs in kitchen are shielded or shatterproof.
Handwashing reminder signs posted at all sinks.
Floor drains are screened, cleaned, and free of odors.
Trash bins are covered and emptied frequently.
All non-food contact surfaces, (walls, floors, ceilings, and shelving) are clean to sight and touch.
